description: BeachFinder is a beach, lake, and swimming-spot discovery service that helps people compare places using mapped spot data, current planning conditions, guides, and community context. It also surfaces related activity providers and beach-planning tools through its website and app.
summary: BeachFinder publishes two public developer surfaces on getbeachfinder.com: a read-only HTTP agent API at `https://getbeachfinder.com/api/v1/agent` with OpenAPI at `https://getbeachfinder.com/openapi.json`, and a read-only remote MCP server at `https://getbeachfinder.com/mcp`; both are documented as requiring no authentication.
